title: Fair Recommender Systems for Intersecting Groups
abstract: arXiv:2610.40936v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommendation systems that optimize for the average user can fail to capture the preferences of diverse demographic groups. We consider a dynamic recommendation system, where arriving users can belong to different demographic groups. Importantly, these groups can intersect, and a user may belong to several groups. We first show that over time, any group-blind policy (which excludes all current-user group information) recommending $K \geq 1$ items incurs linear total regret under mild conditions. In turn, we introduce three group-aware algorithms based on the classical Upper Confidence Bound algorithm (UCB): i) Intersection-Fitting, which runs UCB on each intersection, but has a sublinear group- and intersection-level regret guarantee with an exponential dependence in the number of groups; and ii) two group-level heuristics, Inner-Outer UCB and Group-Item UCB which allocate different arms to different groups, and use a sleeping expert me

translated_title: 面向交叉群体的公平推荐系统
translated_abstract: 针对普通用户进行优化的推荐系统可能无法捕捉不同人口群体的偏好。我们考虑一个动态推荐系统，其中到来的用户可能属于不同的人口群体。重要的是，这些群体之间可能存在交叉，即一个用户可能同时属于多个群体。我们首先证明，在温和的条件下，任何群体盲目的策略（即不使用当前用户群体信息的策略）在推荐 K ≥ 1 个物品时，随时间推移会产生线性的总遗憾。在此基础上，我们基于经典的上置信界算法（UCB）提出了三种群体感知算法：i) 交叉拟合，它在每个交叉群体上运行 UCB，具有次线性的群体级和交叉级遗憾保证，但对群体数量呈指数依赖；以及 ii) 两种群体级启发式算法——内外 UCB 和群体-物品 UCB，它们将不同的臂分配给不同的群体，并使用睡眠专家方法……
tldr: 该论文针对用户可同时属于多个交叉人口群体的动态推荐场景，证明了群体盲目策略必然产生线性遗憾，并提出基于UCB的交叉拟合、内外UCB和群体-物品UCB三种群体感知算法，实现了具有次线性遗憾保证的公平推荐。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that any group-blind policy incurs linear regret in dynamic recommendation settings with intersecting demographic groups, and proposes three UCB-based group-aware algorithms—Intersection-Fitting, Inner-Outer UCB, and Group-Item UCB—to achieve fair recommendation with sublinear regret guarantees.
